verses.original: Διὸ μηκέτι στέγοντες εὐδοκήσαμεν καταλειφθῆναι ἐν Ἀθήναις μόνοι
verses.transliteration: Dio mēketi stegontes eudokēsamen kataleiphthēnai en Athēnais monoi
verses.literal: So when we could bear it no longer we were willing to be left on our own in Athens
verses.literalPt: Por isso, não podendo suportar mais o cuidado por vós, resolvemos ficar a sós em Atenas

verses.original: καὶ ἐπέμψαμεν Τιμόθεον τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν καὶ συνεργὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλέσαι ὑπὲρ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai epempsamen Timotheon ton adelphon hēmōn kai synergon tou Theou en tō euangeliō tou Christou eis to stērixai hymas kai parakalesai hyper tēs pisteōs hymōn
verses.literal: We sent Timothy our brother and fellow worker for God in the gospel of Christ to strengthen and encourage you in your faith
verses.literalPt: e enviamos Timóteo, nosso irmão e ministro de Deus no evangelho de Cristo, para vos fortalecer e vos exortar acerca da vossa fé,

verses.original: τὸ μηδένα σαίνεσθαι ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν ταύταις αὐτοὶ γὰρ οἴδατε ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο κείμεθα
verses.transliteration: to mēdena sainesthai en tais thlipsesin tautais autoi gar oidate hoti eis touto keimetha
verses.literal: so that none of you would be shaken by these trials For you know that we are destined for this
verses.literalPt: para que nenhum de vós seja perturbado nessas tribulações. Vós mesmos sabeis que para isso somos destinados;

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ὅτε πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἦμεν προελέγομεν ὑμῖν ὅτι μέλλομεν θλίβεσθαι καθὼς καὶ ἐγένετο καὶ οἴδατε
verses.transliteration: kai gar hote pros hymas ēmen proelegomen hymin hoti mellomen thlibesthai kathōs kai egeneto kai oidate
verses.literal: Indeed when we were with you we kept warning you . . . that we would suffer persecution and as . . . . . . you know it has come to pass
verses.literalPt: pois, na verdade, quando estávamos convosco, vos dizíamos, de antemão, que havíamos de padecer tribulações, como sucedeu, e vós o sabeis.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο κἀγὼ μηκέτι στέγων ἔπεμψα εἰς τὸ γνῶναι τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν μή πως ἐπείρασεν ὑμᾶς ὁ πειράζων καὶ εἰς κενὸν γένηται ὁ κόπος ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: dia touto kagō mēketi stegōn epempsa eis to gnōnai tēn pistin hymōn mē pōs epeirasen hymas ho peirazōn kai eis kenon genētai ho kopos hēmōn
verses.literal: For this reason . . . when I could bear it no longer I sent to find out about your faith for fear that the tempter had somehow tempted you and that our labor might have been in vain
verses.literalPt: Por isso, não podendo eu esperar mais, mandei informar-me da vossa fé, receando que o Tentador vos tivesse tentado e que o nosso trabalho se torne vão.

verses.original: Ἄρτι δὲ ἐλθόντος Τιμοθέου πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀφ’ ὑμῶν καὶ εὐαγγελισαμένου ἡμῖν τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ὑμῶν καὶ ὅτι ἔχετε μνείαν ἡμῶν ἀγαθὴν πάντοτε ἐπιποθοῦντες ἡμᾶς ἰδεῖν καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Arti de elthontos Timotheou pros hēmas aph’ hymōn kai euangelisamenou hēmin tēn pistin kai tēn agapēn hymōn kai hoti echete mneian hēmōn agathēn pantote epipothountes hēmas idein kathaper kai hēmeis hymas
verses.literal: But just now Timothy has returned . . . . . . from his visit with the good news . . . about your faith your love and the fond memories you have preserved longing to see us just as we long to see you
verses.literalPt: Mas, acabando Timóteo de voltar do meio de vós e trazendo-nos boas notícias da vossa fé, do vosso amor e de que sempre nos tendes em boa lembrança, com muito desejo de ver-nos, assim como nos sucede igualmente para convosco.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο παρεκλήθημεν ἀδελφοί ἐφ’ ὑμῖν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ ἀνάγκῃ καὶ θλίψει ἡμῶν διὰ τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως
verses.transliteration: dia touto pareklēthēmen adelphoi eph’ hymin epi pasē tē anankē kai thlipsei hēmōn dia tēs hymōn pisteōs
verses.literal: For this reason . . . brothers in all our distress and persecution we have been reassured about you because of your faith
verses.literalPt: Por isso, irmãos, no meio de toda a nossa necessidade e tribulação, ficamos consolados em vós pela vossa fé,

verses.original: ὅτι νῦν ζῶμεν ἐὰν ὑμεῖς στήκετε ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: hoti nyn zōmen ean hymeis stēkete en Kyriō
verses.literal: For now we can go on living as long as you are standing firm in the Lord
verses.literalPt: porque agora vivemos, se ficais firmes no Senhor.

verses.original: Τίνα γὰρ εὐχαριστίαν δυνάμεθα τῷ Θεῷ ἀνταποδοῦναι περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ πάσῃ τῇ χαρᾷ ᾗ χαίρομεν δι’ ὑμᾶς ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Tina gar eucharistian dynametha tō Theō antapodounai peri hymōn epi pasē tē chara hē chairomen di’ hymas emprosthen tou Theou hēmōn
verses.literal: How can we adequately thank God for you in return for our great joy over you in His presence . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Pois que ações de graças podemos render a Deus por vós, em atenção a todo o gozo com que nos regozijamos por vossa causa, diante de nosso Deus,

verses.original: νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ δεόμενοι εἰς τὸ ἰδεῖν ὑμῶν τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ καταρτίσαι τὰ ὑστερήματα τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: nyktos kai hēmeras hyperekperissou deomenoi eis to idein hymōn to prosōpon kai katartisai ta hysterēmata tēs pisteōs hymōn
verses.literal: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you face to face and supply what is lacking in your faith
verses.literalPt: quando oramos, com intenso fervor, noite e dia, para que cheguemos a ver a vossa face e completemos o que falta à vossa fé.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς καὶ Πατὴρ ἡμῶν καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦς κατευθύναι τὴν ὁδὸν ἡμῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Autos de ho Theos kai Patēr hēmōn kai ho Kyrios hēmōn Iēsous kateuthynai tēn hodon hēmōn pros hymas
verses.literal: Now may our God and Father Himself and our Lord Jesus direct our way to you
verses.literalPt: Ora, o mesmo Deus e Pai nosso e nosso Senhor Jesus dirijam o nosso caminho para vós.

verses.original: ὑμᾶς δὲ ὁ Κύριος πλεονάσαι καὶ περισσεύσαι τῇ ἀγάπῃ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας καθάπερ καὶ ἡμεῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: hymas de ho Kyrios pleonasai kai perisseusai tē agapē eis allēlous kai eis pantas kathaper kai hēmeis eis hymas
verses.literal: And may the Lord cause you to increase and overflow with love for one another and for everyone else just as our love for you overflows
verses.literalPt: O Senhor vos faça crescer e abundar no amor de uns para com os outros e para com todos, como também nós o fazemos para convosco,

verses.original: εἰς τὸ στηρίξαι ὑμῶν τὰς καρδίας ἀμέμπτους ἐν ἁγιωσύνῃ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ μετὰ πάντων τῶν ἁγίων αὐτοῦ ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: eis to stērixai hymōn tas kardias amemptous en hagiōsynē emprosthen tou Theou kai patros hēmōn en tē parousia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou meta pantōn tōn hagiōn autou amēn
verses.literal: so that He may establish your hearts in blamelessness and holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all His saints Amen
verses.literalPt: a fim de fortalecer os vossos corações, de maneira que sejam irrepreensíveis em santidade diante de nosso Deus e Pai, na vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus, com todos os seus santos.
